entities.name: Kévin Hecquefeuille
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kévin Hecquefeuille is a French ice hockey coach in the role of assistant for the EHC Visp in Switzerland Swiss League. He previously played as a defenseman, in a career that lasted from 2002 to 2022. Internationally Hecquefeuille played for the French national team in multiple World Championships.
